Select the first 200 metabolism records for the enzyme UGT1A9. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to get the substrate molregno, then join to compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join to molecule_dictionary to get substrate compound names. Optionally join to molecule_hierarchy anchored from the substrate molregno to retrieve parent compound names. Return canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name.
